entities.title: Spawning
entities.summary: Where new objects are placed, and the periodic spawn when the main counter reaches 0.
entities.purpose: Places the hostile template, the alien group, launches straight ahead and a ship's children (RULES B.10.3 to B.10.6), and runs the periodic spawn (B.10.8, C.16), drawing from the main generator in RULES' order.
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
It does not run the arrivals' AI; that is the ai and combat capabilities'.
